finding.title: Appending to a valid JSONL archive without terminal newline corrupts the archive
finding.proof: Executed isolated test using byte-identical storage.py (git hash-object matched), stub FlowObservation. First append=1; strip terminal newline; load=1; duplicate retry=0; distinct second append=1; physical lines=1; subsequent load raises ValueError Extra data. Control with newline: two appends, load=2. No exact-repo pytest or production incident claimed.
finding.distinct: Valid unterminated JSONL row plus append causes new corruption; not prior malformed historical row, concurrency race, or replay horizon.
finding.oracle: At pinned HEAD with real FlowObservation and tempfile: append row A; remove ONLY terminal newline (valid JSONL); assert load A succeeds and duplicate retry is 0; append distinct B; assert archive remains two independently parseable records and sequential run_once(network=False,external_jsonl=[B],as_of_ms=fixed) refreshes latest/audit_latest/anata_latest/evidence_health/PIT. Pre-fix expect ValueError after B. Include no-newline and newline controls, repair/retry. Targeted python -m pytest -q part2/capital_flow/tests/test_providers_replay.py part2/capital_flow/tests/test_evidence_health.py part2/capital_flow/tests/test_v1_handoff.py and full python -m pytest -q part2/capital_flow/tests.
